scope: Synchronous reuse of identical H0 deltas with independent transport histories
provenance: Synthetic real Soldier fire and the existing independent-decoder communication-wheel scenarios; one separately marked original PvE twenty-hero hotspot capture
cacheLifetime: One Observers.update call; no persistent VM or transport state
contracts: Encoded chunk bits and key contents match uncached computation
Each stream receives a distinct mutable delivery key set
Cached baseline and current snapshots remain alive until the cache expires
Different ACK, loss, descriptor knowledge or callout stamps do not share a result
Each observer is still sent its own record and retains its own ACK/loss state

expected.secondViewerLostFirstDelta: Recovers to the same decoded instances, states, variables and descriptor sources
expected.voiceAndDirectedCallouts: Original retry stamps and each speaker survive divergent acknowledgements
